authentication: Existing saved USB pairing and keychain token; no LAN listener. Windows pending journals protected with current-user DPAPI.
thread_model: Socket worker returns bounded job ticket; reviewed UI/native operations execute on main queue; no socket/main-queue semaphore dependency.
identity: opaque weak native handles + occurrence generation + consumer epoch
memory: Self-process ARM64 vm_map APIs. Read mapped readable regions; write already writable non-executable regions after expected-byte comparison; read back; owner-bound rollback requires current bytes match prior replacement. No protection escalation; concurrent writes not atomic.
calls: Fixed reviewed Objective-C return/argument encodings and compiled C prototypes only; arbitrary calls/CPP/aggregates/registers/breakpoints require optional external LLDB.
reconnect: Same nonce/job identity only. Mutation tombstones prevent repetition after bounded result eviction; unknown outcomes retained, never replayed into a new process. Disable opt-in resets nonce and agent state while preserving pairing.

lldb.transport: Selected UDID, userspace tunnel, localhost-only Apple debugproxy relay
lldb.identity: Local ARM64 target and optional DWARF symbol UUIDs match agent loaded-image snapshot before attach.
